defect: the source may change data before the destination samples it because no valid-hold contract is stated
rationale: The clocks are related by a declared divide-by-two relationship, but the environment contract does not say that src_data_i remains stable for the destination sampling window. The direct payload crossing can consequently be safe or unsafe depending on that unstated assumption.

mutation.description: Kept the isochronous crossing but omitted the source-side requirement to hold payload stable until consumption.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced to the direct payload and valid crossing, with the source hold guarantee intentionally left external.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: dst is a divide-by-2 of src, so a one-cycle src_valid_i pulse can fall between dst edges; whether valid is held two cycles is an unstated environment protocol.
